title: Campinas - Elizangela Silva | Vendas – Seguro de Vida e Previdência (Autônomo – Atuação Presencial)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão?

Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira .

Se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você !

Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula — onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas — até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará — com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas — as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Conheça as vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira parceiro da MAG Seguros:

  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;

Após a conquista da Habilitação:

  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará, se possuir:

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações adicionais

PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:

  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow and inefficient financial system. NuPay is a primary pillar in Nubank’s mission to revolutionize BNPL (Buy Now, Pay Later) solutions, creating a seamless bridge between customers and merchants. By stripping away the friction of traditional e-commerce checkouts, we are building an ecosystem where secure, instant payments are accessible across all channels—from online carts to physical stores via digital wallets.

You will join the NuPay team as a technical anchor, driving the evolution of a payments stack that balances massive scale with ironclad reliability. This role is about more than just moving bits; it’s about architecting the financial infrastructure that millions of people and businesses rely on to grow, ensuring every transaction is a bridge of trust between Nubank and our partners.

As a senior technical leader, you will oversee the technical direction of our payment features, navigating the complexities of authorization and settlement while mentoring the next generation of engineers. You will sit at the intersection of product innovation and platform stability, ensuring our checkout experience remains the gold standard for Latin American fintech.

  • Define engineering standards for architecture, observability, and security, influencing multiple squads to uphold a high quality bar.
  • Collaborate with Risk and Finance teams to engineer solutions that satisfy complex regulatory requirements without compromising the user experience.
Required Qualifications
  • Track record of technical leadership in architecting complex, distributed software environments at scale.
  • Deep expertise in high-availability systems , with demonstrated ability to perform rigorous trade-off analysis for long-term scalability.
  • Background in high-criticality FinTech , specifically within Payments or Core Banking environments governed by strict SLAs.
  • Evidence of delivering high-throughput systems using modern engineering practices, including automated testing, observability, and safe rollout strategies.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers , fostering a culture of technical excellence and shared ownership across organizational boundaries.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with acquiring, sub-acquiring, or payment gateway architecture.
  • Previous involvement with e-commerce or marketplace platforms managing proprietary payment stacks.
Location & Work Model

This role is based in São Paulo or Campinas, Brazil or Toronto, Canada or Buenos Aires, Argentina on a Hybrid model .

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

title: LATAM Engineering Director - Power Conversion
description:
Job Description Summary

The Director of Engineering leads a comprehensive organization of Design, Product, Test and Process engineers responsible for the end-to-end design of Large Rotating Machines (motors, generators and synchronous condensers), Transformers, Power Drives, Switch Gear and Complex Systems for a variety of industry segments. With design authority (under corporate standards), you will be responsible for major and complex assignments with long-term business implications, manage complex issues within functional areas of expertise, and be instrumental to the overall business strategy.

Job Description

Role Summary/Purpose:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) for the Power Conversion and Storage division in Latin America, the LATAM Director of Engineering will lead Engineering on Rotating machines (induction, DC, synchronous, PMM, synch reluctance, and other topologies) and Engineering of integrated electrical solutions (system design and integration, power electronics, automation, switchboards and installation) for products and projects within LATAM or exported from LATAM to many global regions, notably North America, Europe and the Middle East.

The role is both operational and strategic. It demands:

  • Transformational leadership skills – to guide the large organizational structure towards productivity, process standardization & maturity, speed and use of leading edge technology tools;

  • Technical depth – to foster an environment of creativity and innovative solutions, and to develop new business opportunities;

  • Seniority and executive presence – to interact with the customers in Latin America and abroad on complex engineering projects.

  • The role requires focus towards growth on the Latam region operation, and he/she will leverage the GE network, to drive product innovation, technology injections, structuring and cost-out through tools and processes in the areas of power electronics, automation, power systems, switchgears, rotor dynamics, vibration, electromagnetics, insulation, aero-thermo, structural, and both electrical and mechanical systems integration.

Essential Responsibilities:

  • The LATAM Director of Engineering directs a functional area of several engineering departments across the sites of Campinas, SP and Belo Horizonte, MG. Executes projects with great customer engagement and trust. Translates concepts, considers strategic options, develops tactics, and implements change. Creates programs in alignment with the external environment. Participates in cross-functional , multi-cultural teams.

  • Drives team performance to meet aggressive time and cost demands from our customers.

  • Develop, implement, and achieve performance KPIs.

  • Develop a roadmap for building world-class products and solutions, including electric machines, power electronics, switchgears, software and overall systems design capability.

  • Serves as technical expert in the technical community through demonstrated technical accomplishments which may include holding patents, component design and systems design experience, and strong knowledge of engineering design fundamentals.

  • Drives customer project execution and delivers on time and quality.

  • Leads and oversees quality engineering design, execution, and product safety; responsible for the oversight of the related sciences including materials and performance.

  • Provides guidance, leadership, mentoring and intervention, as necessary, to strengthen the discipline, quality, reliability and rigor of our engineering work.

  • Leads interactions with customers on technical issues.

  • Works with Power Conversion leadership to develop and build long term strategies.

  • Interacts with P&L engineering and technology leaders across GE to accelerate deployment of modern electrical and mechanical design tools and methodologies.

  • Works with P&L product leadership to reshape the overall Latam technical strategy and the organizational structure.

  • Provides leadership with high integrity and oversight of processes protecting intellectual property, export controlled and strategic technology.

Required Qualification:

  • Degree in Electric or Mechanical Engineering
  • Strong knowledge of Engineering Design Fundamentals and Engineering Processes
  • Extensive experience in mechanical and/or electrical systems design
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese mandatory
  • Industrial experience in relevant industry segments such as Oil and Gas, Power Generation, Mining & Steel and/or Marine will be a plus.
  • Subject Matter Expertise on Rotating Machines and/or Electrical Systems will be a plus.
Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

description:
SENIOR DATA SCIENTIST (AI CENTER OF EXCELLENCE) - 33923
  • The LA AI & Data Center of Excellence seeks a highly skilled and motivated Senior Data Scientist to join our team.
  • This role focuses on developing and deploying cutting‑edge AI solutions, emphasizing automation, software engineering best practices, and production‑ready code.
  • This role requires proficiency in Python programming and experience with various machine learning, deep learning, generative and agentic AI.
  • The successful candidate will work on projects across diverse business units, directly impacting critical decision‑making and driving innovation.
  • You will be able to lead the development of intelligent systems with a strong emphasis on software and AI engineering best practices, automation, and continuous delivery.
Experience and Knowledge (Mandatory)
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, or Physics. (Ph.D. in a relevant field is a plus).
  • Proven Track Record: Deep experience as an individual contributor in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering, consistently delivering high‑impact AI solutions in complex, real‑world enterprise environments.
  • Business Acumen & Leadership: Strong ability to assess the business impact of AI models, including cost‑benefit analysis, ROI estimation, and value tracking post‑deployment. Proven ability to mentor junior data scientists and guide technical decisions within agile squads.
  • Expert‑Level Python: Advanced proficiency in Python, including Pandas, Polars, NumPy, Scikit‑learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras. Experience with Flask/FastAPI for RESTful API development.
  • Software Engineering Excellence: Strong foundation in OOP, Clean Code principles, and modular design. Hands‑on experience with version control (Git), unit testing, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • End‑to‑End ML Lifecycle: Deep expertise in data preparation, model training, tuning, inference, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
  • Data Handling & Integration: Expertise in ETL processes from various sources (relational/non‑relational databases, cloud storage, APIs). Experience with SQL, NoSQL, vector databases, and integrating AI outputs with core enterprise systems (e.g., ERPs).
  • Core ML & NLP: Strong grasp of supervised and unsupervised learning techniques (regression, classification, clustering, time series). Solid foundation in Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques and libraries.
  • Generative AI: Practical experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, fine‑tuning, and architecting RAG pipelines.
  • Cloud Platforms: Experience designing and operating data pipelines and deploying models on major cloud platforms, Azure (preferred), GCP, or AWS, leveraging their respective AI/ML services.
  • Languages: Native/fluent Portuguese (Brazilian) and fluent English. German is a strong plus.
  • Profile & Working Method: Team player with strong analytical thinking, proactive problem‑solving skills, and resilience. Self‑taught mentality with a continuous passion for staying current with AI advancements.
  • Communication: Exceptional ability to collaborate in cross‑functional teams and translate complex technical insights into accessible, actionable information for diverse business stakeholders.
Experience and Knowledge (Desirable)
  • Enterprise AI Ecosystems & Agentic Workflows: Experience architecting secure solutions using platforms like Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot Studio or n8n. Hands‑on experience building multi‑agent systems using frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, LangFlow) and communication protocols (MCP, WebMCP, A2A).
  • Hyperautomation & Cognitive Technologies: Experience moving beyond simple task automation by leveraging an integrated ecosystem of Low‑Code/No‑Code, AI/ML, and Process Mining to architect end‑to‑end business workflows.
  • Advanced MLOps & Data Engineering: Experience with MLFlow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Familiarity with big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, Databricks) and data warehousing.
  • Computer Vision: Experience applying deep learning to computer vision use cases.
  • Knowledge Graphs: Experience with graph‑based data representations (Neo4j, RDF, SPARQL) or graph neural networks for reasoning and relationship modeling.
  • Domain Expertise: Specialized knowledge in specific industries, HR, marketing, laws, or supply chain.
